Six brokers · Est. 2014

The agent collective.

We kept the brokerage small on purpose. Every agent on this page has been working the Hudson Valley for at least a decade and has the kind of reference list you can actually call. They will pick up the phone.

Eleanor Whitfield

Principal Broker · Founder
Tenure
22 years in the valley · founded H&O 2014
Specialty
Historic homes, working farms, land assemblage
Towns
Rhinebeck, Red Hook, Tivoli, Clermont
License
NYS #10311202784

Eleanor opened Heron & Oak after a decade at a regional brokerage that, in her words, "stopped paying attention to the houses." She founded the firm with two clear rules: every property gets a broker who has actually walked the perimeter of the lot, and every buyer hears the truth about the basement.

She has spent two decades getting to know the historic housing stock of northern Dutchess and southern Columbia counties — from Federal-period townhouses in Rhinebeck to working farms above the Hudson — and is the broker most often called when an estate or family trust needs to sell something complicated.

She lives outside Tivoli with two dogs, an aging Subaru, and a steadily expanding collection of regional pottery.

View Eleanor's Listings (845) 555-0118 eleanor@heronandoak.example

Owen Sato

Associate Broker
Tenure
14 years · joined H&O 2016
Specialty
Urban rowhouses, mixed-use, restoration projects
Towns
Hudson, Catskill, Athens, Coxsackie
License
NYS #40521198341

Owen came to brokerage by way of preservation carpentry, which is the long answer to why his clients all leave him voicemails about sash windows. He has done the work — replaced sills, reglazed cabinet doors, pulled a chimney down a course at a time — and that history shapes how he talks to buyers about what an old building actually needs.

He runs the Hudson side of the brokerage with a focus on the rowhouses and mixed-use buildings that define the Warren Street corridor, and is the agent we send when a property has been on and off the market a few times and needs someone willing to start over with the seller.

He lives above his office in a building he restored over four years.

View Owen's Listings (518) 555-0104 owen@heronandoak.example

Maya Bertrand-Cole

Salesperson
Tenure
10 years · joined H&O 2019
Specialty
Small farms, land with intent, mid-century
Towns
New Paltz, Gardiner, Stone Ridge, High Falls
License
NYS #10401218905

Maya works the southern half of the territory and brings a background in agricultural easements and conservation law to the practice. She is the broker we send when a buyer is trying to think clearly about land — how much is enough, what they will actually use, what the soil will and will not do.

She represented buyers on three of the most carefully done small-farm purchases in Ulster County over the past four years, and is the agent who taught the rest of us how to read a county GIS overlay in under five minutes.

She lives in a 1960s glass house outside New Paltz that she has spent three years quietly improving without changing.

View Maya's Listings (845) 555-0132 maya@heronandoak.example

Theo Ortega

Associate Broker
Tenure
16 years · joined H&O 2017
Specialty
Victorians, hillside properties, off-grid
Towns
Catskill, Saugerties, Woodstock, Phoenicia
License
NYS #10311189226

Theo grew up in Saugerties and has the kind of working knowledge of the Mountaintop that comes from spending twenty-five winters reading the road conditions on the way home. He represents the Catskill-side properties — Victorians along the river, hillside cabins, the occasional off-grid build — and is the broker most likely to know who built a given house and which of their grandkids still lives in town.

He is also the agent we send when a property is hard to access, hard to value, or hard to explain. He brings a level head to every showing and a clear, patient explanation of what well water actually means.

He lives on a quiet road outside Saugerties with his husband and a workshop in progress.

Camille Reyes-Hahn

Salesperson
Tenure
11 years · joined H&O 2020
Specialty
Craftsman bungalows, first-time buyers, in-village
Towns
Saugerties, Kingston, Rosendale
License
NYS #10401222716

Camille is the broker who, more than any of us, has reset what it means to represent a first-time buyer in this market. She brings a careful, slow approach that treats the buyer's time and savings with as much respect as the seller's price. The result is a lot of small, smart purchases — bungalows, side-street starters, in-village houses that quietly appreciate.

She also handles the brokerage's continuing-education program, which is to say she is the reason the rest of us know the current rules and not the rules from three cycles ago.

She lives in Kingston with her wife and two children and is the only one of us with a vegetable garden that actually produces.

View Camille's Listings (845) 555-0144 camille@heronandoak.example

Jonah Becker

Associate Broker · Beacon Office Lead
Tenure
13 years · joined H&O 2018
Specialty
Live/work conversions, transit-oriented, commercial
Towns
Beacon, Cold Spring, Newburgh
License
NYS #10311208114

Jonah runs the Beacon office and represents the southern end of the territory — the train-line towns where commute time and walkability are real factors and the housing stock skews a little more recent. He brought a previous life in commercial leasing to the practice, which makes him the agent we send for mixed-use buildings, loft conversions, and anything with a CO question.

He is fluent in the realities of a Metro-North commute, has talked dozens of New York–based buyers through the math of working from a Beacon kitchen instead, and is unfailingly honest about which blocks are quiet and which are not.

He lives a short walk from the office in a small house he bought, fixed, and rents the back unit of.
